title: Call hierarchy display and workspace paths
source: Artemis archive, taskset typescript-astra-compression-criteria-2026-11-04 (frozen 2026-11-04); prompts and criteria copied unchanged

criteria.behavior: File/module call-hierarchy items display the basename as their name and the containing directory as detail; absolute file URI, navigation spans, and incoming/outgoing call targets remain correct.
With a containing workspace, directory detail is relative to the most-specific containing workspace folder.
With multiple workspace folders, the chosen folder’s display name prefixes the relative detail, so same-named files in different folders remain distinguishable.
Workspace roots supplied during LSP initialization are honored: workspaceFolders takes precedence, with rootUri/rootPath fallback when appropriate.

A directory equal to a workspace root resolves against its parent instead of producing empty detail; files outside every workspace, or with no containing workspace, retain the absolute containing directory.
Workspace containment, nested-root selection, and relative path display honor the repository’s existing platform case-sensitivity and path-normalization conventions.
Workspace information reaches language-service requests and remains correct across snapshots and repeated requests without changing unrelated symbol-node display behavior.
